scientific_integrity: Derived from the stated best-response model; arbitrary-size results proved analytically. Finite exact checks supplement but do not replace proof. Independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous zero-prejudice synchronous best-response, directed row-stochastic influence near a cyclic permutation. Exponential global attraction only for the exact permutation; perturbed cycles locally attracting. No claim on single-agent asynchronous revision or all network classes.
title: Attracting cycles of unbounded period in a public-goods opinion–action game
